reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water behaves in Provincia! Our new native sparse cellular automata system keeps ponds affordable and enhances the flow map. Additionally, turning on a well no longer causes frame freezes. Dive into the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: New Water Dynamics in Provincia!
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce updates to the water mechanics in Provincia! With our new native sparse cellular automata system, ponds are now more affordable, and we've resolved frame freeze issues when activating wells. Check out the full details in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
